title: Reviewer feedback on one practice question (POST /v1/feedback)
description: Sent by web/js/data/api.js (feedbackPayload), accepted by coding_tutor.live.feedback. No email, account or IP address; `name` is optional and typed by the reviewer. Stored privately; there is no public read endpoint.

scenario.description: the question's scenario id, e.g. ckd_staging-0123456789

kind.description: what is wrong: the answer key, the explanation, the clinical note, or something else

expected.description: the code(s) the reviewer expected, optional
